subject: COLUMN clause
notes: Rule: 'Any unoccupied columns in each print line are filled with space characters.' (cite.py --check 13.18.14.4 -> OK 10)). ReportWriter.NewLine allocates the line buffer space-filled; Place writes only the item's columns. Probe p1 line 5 ' AABB      CD' - column 1 and columns 6-11 are spaces; pb951's ' Z   ' and 'W XY ' pin interior blanks. (Trailing spaces are dropped by the line-sequential record write, a file-organization matter outside this rule.)
